placements.title: The analytics pipeline's query performance and licensing cost, not its incumbent database, now decide the data platform
placements.frame: What performance gain and licensing cost does the analytics pipeline demand of its data platform, and by when must the switch land?
placements.why: The envelope's only position holds a forward-directed commitment ("We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB"), its stated rationale (10x analytical queries, lower licensing cost) and its Q3 2026 landing date. The migration itself is a one-time event and stays at position grain; what is true beyond these words is the standing subject — the analytics pipeline's performance-and-cost profile as the basis on which its data platform is chosen. No existing narrative structure was supplied, so nothing can be reused and nothing is close enough for lineage; the leaf stands standalone.
